Murder In Groblersdal

By: ALTYDVRYSTAAT PRODUCTIONS | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We investigate a farm murder where all is not what it appears to be.

Unique Selling Point:
A month after a farmer from Groblersdal was murdered, his widows girlfriend was arrested. Carte Blanche investigates...



Summary:
After midnight of an early October evening in 2019 three shots rang out on a farm near Groblersdal in Limpopo. There was a moment's pause before seven more gunshots broke the early morning silence.
Afterwards, a young farmer, Raymond Papapavlou lay dead. His wife of two years, Simoné was a broken woman.
She later told police she had fallen asleep on a couch in the TV room, while her husband was asleep in the bedroom when their dog reacted to a shadow. Suddenly three shots rang out from within the bedroom. Raymond was mortally struck and Simoné, who had a pistol with her, fired seven "warning shots" into the wall.
The intruder managed to escape and yet another farm murder was added to the statistics.
But all did not seem to be what it appeared to be.
The next morning two teams of professional trackers went over the farm with a fine toothed comb. Not a single strange track was found in the area surrounding the house.The window used as an entry point, according to Simoné, seemed suspiciously small. Big enough for a small child to gain silent access, but almost impossible for an adult sized intruder.
A month later the small rural community was shocked when a 22-year old friend of Simon's, Patricia Ray-Lee Smith, was arrested and charged with murder and conspiracy to murder.
An even greater surprise waited in Smith's charge sheet; Another name - Simoné Papapavlou.
Up to date, Papapavlou has never been arrested and Smith was released on bail on 27 November 2020.
We will be talking to farmer and road builder, Japie Jonker. He is Raymond Papapavlou's uncle. Jonker also rented the farm for Raymond and his young wife to stay on.
Jonker will take CB to the farm and talk us through the events of that horrible night.
At the moment our insert will consist of interviews with Jonker, as well as a member of the professional tracking team and also the private detective who traced and arrested Smith, ex-police colonel Gawie Louwrens..



Further information:
This is a developing story. We will have more info and solid leads by Monday

Script:


UPSOUND
“Gunshots, ambience”
LINK It was in this house on a remote farm near Groblersdal where tragedy stuck on the 4th of October 2020.
V/O 28-year old farmer and professional hunter, Raymond Papapavlou was shot and killed in his sleep. His wife, Simoné was also in the house at the time, and called for help.
Dawie Toe die boodskap op die veiligheidsgroep deurgekom, omtrent 10 voor twaalf. Toe sê hulle dis ‘n plaasaanval en toe jaag ons almal. Ons het so 4 minute oor twaalf, toe’s ons hier gewees…

The message came through on the security group at about ten to twelve. They said it was a farm attack. We all rushed to the scene. At about four minutes past twelve we were here.
V/O Papapavlou’s friend, Dawie Pieterse was first on the scene.
Dawie Ons het so reg rondom gestop dat ons bakkies ligte op die huis gooi. En toe ons inkom het sy bakkie nog hier op die stoep gestaan. Toe het ek hier by die deur gekom, toe vra ek vir haar, waar’s Raymond…

We parked right around so that our bakkies shined their lights on the house. When we entered his bakkie was still standing here on the stoep. Then I got to the door and asked her: “Where is Raymond?”
V/O The shaken widow was waiting outside, unclear about what had transpired.
Dawie Toe sê sy net vir my nee, sy weet nie… toe gaan ek in om te gaan kyk waar is hy.

Then she just said: “No, I don’t know.” Then I went in to see where he was.
V/O Pieterse entered the house not knowing what to expect.
Dawie Toe ek hier gekom het, die bed het so gestaan, toe sien ek daar is iets op die bed maar ek kon nie sien is dit hy, wat is dit nie. Toe het ek my selfoon se lig aangesit om te kan sien want die lig werk gladnie.

Daar’s 5 skote deur hom. Een deur die kop en die res is deur die lyf.

Claire: I don’t know how you must feel to be in this room again…

When I got here the bed stood here. Then I saw there was something on the bed, but I couldn’t see if it was him, or what it was. Then I switched my cell phone light on to see because this light doesn’t work at all. Five shots went through him. One through the head and the rest through the body.
Dawie Almal het van hom gehou. Hy was soos ‘n teddybeer -- groot, gentle, sagte hart.

Everyone liked him. He was like a teddy bear. Gig, gentle, soft heart.
UPSOUND Sorry...
Japie Almal was lief vir Raymond. Altyd die meisies beskerm op skool. Hy was regtig ‘n wonderlike kind.

Everyone loved Raymond. Always protected the girls at school. He really was a wonderful child.
V/O Raymond Papapavlou worked for his uncle, Japie Jonker for over a decade and the two had a special bond.
Japie Baie lief vir sy visvang. Hy’t provinsiale klere in visvang van baie kleins af. Altyd saam met sy pa gaan visvang.

He loved fishing. He had provincial colours in fishing from an early age. Always went fishing with his dad.
V/O On that fateful night Jonker also arrived at the farmhouse just after midnight.
Japie Toe ek in die kamer kom en sien wat gebeur het, het ek inmekaar gesak. Toe het die buurman my opgetel en my uitgebring.

When I got to the room and saw what had happened I collapsed, then the neighbour picked me up and carried me out.
V/O While Raymond was asleep in their bed, Simoné says she dozed off in front of the TV, in the room right next to the bedroom.
Japie Die TV het teen die muur gestaan en die banke was teen daai muur daarso.

The television stood against this wall and the couches were against that wall over there.
Japie Sy’t wakker geword van ‘n skoot. En toe spring sy op en toe het sy die waarskuwingskote geskiet.

She woke up from a gunshot and then she jumped up and fired the warning shots.
V/O She fired her gun seven times, called for help and ran outside.
Dawie Claire: Did you even know she owned a gun?

Ja, 9mm and a 306.

Claire: And what do the casings say? Do we know what type of gun shot him?

Ek weet nog nie maar die waarskuwingskote is met haar wapen geskiet. Met die 9mm. In die kamer waar hy gelê het kon ons niks casings kry nie.

I don’t know yet but the warning shots were fired from her weapon, the 9mm. In the room where he lay we could not find any casings.
V/O The murder weapon has not been found.

According to Simoné the attackers entered the house through this window next to the front door - the only one in the house without burglar bars.
Dawie Hierso was ‘n stoof gewees met drie potte op want hulle aandete gemaak het. Maar hier aan die buitekant was daar 2 moere gewees wat nie afgeval het nie.

Here was a stove with three pots on because they made supper. Here on the outside were two nuts that did not fall off, and here was dust.

. A leading question

.

LINK Dawie says nothing was disturbed at the alleged entry point into the house.For those who arrived on the scene shortly after the incident it quickly became apparent to them that this was no ordinary farm murder. iIt left them with more questions than answers.
Japie Alles was in sy plek. Die rekenaar het daar gelê, beursies…

Everything was in its place. The computer lay there, the wallets...

This is a leading question, not happy with it
. It lay openly on the table.

Dawie Toe’t ons begin soek en kyk of ons nie vreemde voetspore kry of iets in die lyn nie, maar ons kon niks kry nie. Saam met die polisie kon ons ook niks optel nie.

Then we started looking for strange footprints or something along those lines, but we found nothing. Even with the police we could not pick up anything.
V/O As news of the brutal attack started to spread, others too questioned the events of that night.
Samantha Claire: So in your mind when you heard farm murder was that a reality for you or did you think uhm-uhm? Another leading question, should have left it open and allowed Samantha to answer without the options. But this one can go

Uh-uhmm… I phoned my friend immediately and I said to her something is wrong.
V/O Samantha Kemp and her husband were close friends with the Papapavlous until 2018…
Samantha Raymond was a very light sleeper.
Claire: Oh, really?
He spent weekends here.
So when I read he was sleeping, an intruder broke in and… It didn't make sense to me because I know Raymond … and then also his wallet and he smokes and everything else next to his bed that remained there.

V/O Having known the couple intimately, Kemp insists some things don’t add up.
Samantha They’ve got “varkhonde”.
Claire: Yes.
Yeah. And I know when we go visit them, he used to close those dogs because they were vicious and alert.
Samantha: And I mean, there were people scared of the dogs, terrified. Wouldn't you be?
Claire: I would but that’s a whole different story.
Terrified. I mean, even us. Who knew some of the dogs were still terrified of them.
V/O According to the widow their bull terrier was with her in the TV room. She has said that the attackers closed the door, blocking the dog from attack.
Japie As die deur toegetrek is, waar sou die skote gewees het? Op die muur, nie in die deur nie.

If the door was closed, where would the shots have been? On the wall, not in the door.
Dawie En ons het hier aangekom en daai hond het nie eers vir ons geblaf nie. Hy was kalm, kalm, kalm. En daar was ‘n klein hondjie wat blykbaar by hom in die kamer was maar toe ons hier kom toe is hy toegemaak in ‘n hok agter. En niemand kan vir ons sê hoe die hond daar gekom het nie.

We got here and that dog didn’t even bark at us. He was calm, calm. And there was a small dog that apparently was with him in the room but when we got here he was closed in a cage at the back, and no-one can explain how the dog got there.
LINK The story took an even more bizarre turn with the arrest of Simoné’s friend at the end of October last year.
V/O 22-year old Patricia Ray-Lee Smith was arrested and charged for conspiracy to commit murder.

Japie Sy’t by my gewerk. Hulle was saam site agents, en ek dink dis waar hulle bevriend geraak het… dis maar daar by die werk.

She worked for me. Together they were site agents. I think that’s where they befriended each other, at work.

Claire: It was an innocent friendship from the outside?

Daar was baie stories en ek het net gesê vir my gaan dit oor die werk.

Ja there were many stories. There were many stories but I said for me it was about the job.
V/O Another surprise waited in court. Simoné Papapavlou’s was cited as co-accused on the charge sheet, but she has not been arrested or charged. According to the media, police have found incriminating whatsapp messages between Smith and the widow, but the prosecution is not revealing any information while the investigation is ongoing.
Dawie Claire: Do you still have questions?

Baie baie en ek wens ek het antwoorde gehad. Maar daar is nog nie antwoorde nie.

Many, many, many, and I wish I had the answers but there are no answers yet.
V/O Raymond and Simone first met in 2015 and Kemp says there was instant chemistry.
Samantha Claire: Who showed interest?

Raymond showed interest first.

Claire: Really, did he fall hard for her?

Very.

V/O But the fairytale did not last and many saw warning signs. Friends tried to warn Raymond.
Samantha If she wanted something and he didn't give it to her, she would manipulate him with sex.
Claire: She had control over him.
Totally. My husband asked Raymond has she got like a spell on you, is there a voodoo doll. Can't you see the signs? So he just said he has to stand by her.
V/O At the end of 2018 Raymond proposed, and Simoné asked Kemp to be her maid-of-honour.
Samantha We were sitting outside the one morning and then she admitted to me she’s bisexual… and then I said I think the person that you’re marrying should know this first. And then after the conversation that they had she slammed down the phone and she said to me in Afrikaans “Ek hoop net hy sal vrek” and then I was like taken aback and then she said but she’ll make sure his policies are in order first. That was like… boom!

V/O The couples’ friendship came to an end when Raymond insisted on going ahead with the wedding.
Samantha Raymond just wanted a boeremeisie.
Claire: Salt of the earth, simple.
Simple, he just wanted a boeremeisie. And then he got this queen...
LINK Even after they were married their relationship was rocky and they ended up separating for some months. But eventually Simoné sent Raymond this email to ask for a reconciliation. In it she says I am sorry for all the pain that I caused you, and I’m sorry for all the awful things that I said to you. Raymond I forgive you.
Japie En toe het sy teruggekom en toe’s sy weer weg. Omtrent ‘n maand. En na die tyd toe vind ek uit Raymond moes ‘n kontrak teken, toe sy terugkom het sy hom ‘n kontrak maak teken dat alles hare is. En toe het sy die laaste keer teruggekom - begin laasjaar - en uhmm, my eerste woorde was “ek hoop jy is terug vir die regte redes. Vir my het hulle vir die eerste keer gelukkig gelyk. Ek het regtig gedink hulle is gelukkig.

She came back, and then she left again, about a month later. Afterwards I found out Raymond had to sign a contract, when she came back she made him sign a contract that everything is hers. When she came back the last time, at the beginning of last year, my first words to her were: “I hope you’re back for the right reasons.” To me they looked happy for the first time. I really thought they were happy.
Samantha He loved her so much he would tolerate anything that came in his way… and now he had to die...
V/O We approached Simoné and her lawyer for comment, but they have not responded to any of the questions. Smith is currently out on bail, awaiting her next court appearance on the 11th of June. In the meantime family and friends just want answers.
Japie Claire: And you believe that will bring a bit of closure if justice is done… or is too much lost already?

Dit sal nooit die seer wegvat nie maar ten minste sal ek weet die skuldiges het nie weggekom nie.

It will never take the pain away, but at least I will know the guilty parties did not get away with it.


PROMO 1 The brutal murder of a young Limpopo farmer late last year left family and friends devastated, with more questions than answers. Was this a farm attack or something more sinister?

PROMO 2 A young farmer was shot and killed in his sleep in October last year, but this was not your typical farm attack. Will family and friends get the answers they desperately need?

PROMO 3 Another farm murder or something a lot more sinister? We trace the events of the night in October 2020 that left a young Limpopo farmer dead in his bed.

Japie Die TV het teen die muur gestaan en die banke was teen daai muur daarso. The television stood against this wall and the couches were against that wall over there. Japie Sy’t wakker geword van ‘n skoot. En toe spring sy op en toe het sy die waarskuwingskote geskiet. She woke up from a gunshot and then she jumped up and fired the warning shots. V/O She fired her gun seven times, called for help and ran outside. Dawie Claire: Did you even know she owned a gun? Ja, 9mm and a 306. Claire: And what do the casings say? Do we know what type of gun shot him? Ek weet nog nie maar die waarskuwingskote is met haar wapen geskiet. Met die 9mm. In die kamer waar hy gelê het kon ons niks casings kry nie. I don’t know yet but the warning shots were fired from her weapon, the 9mm. In the room where he lay we could not find any casings. V/O The murder weapon has not been found. According to Simoné the attackers entered the house through this window next to the front door - the only one in the house without burglar bars. Dawie Hierso was ‘n stoof gewees met drie potte op want hulle aandete gemaak het. Maar hier aan die buitekant was daar 2 moere gewees wat nie afgeval het nie. Here was a stove with three pots on because they made supper. Here on the outside were two nuts that did not fall off, and here was dust. . A leading question . LINK Dawie says nothing was disturbed at the alleged entry point into the house.For those who arrived on the scene shortly after the incident it quickly became apparent to them that this was no ordinary farm murder. iIt left them with more questions than answers. Japie Alles was in sy plek. Die rekenaar het daar gelê, beursies… Everything was in its place. The computer lay there, the wallets... This is a leading question, not happy with it . It lay openly on the table. Dawie Toe’t ons begin soek en kyk of ons nie vreemde voetspore kry of iets in die lyn nie, maar ons kon niks kry nie. Saam met die polisie kon ons ook niks optel nie. Then we started looking for strange footprints or something along those lines, but we found nothing. Even with the police we could not pick up anything. V/O As news of the brutal attack started to spread, others too questioned the events of that night. Samantha Claire: So in your mind when you heard farm murder was that a reality for you or did you think uhm-uhm? Another leading question, should have left it open and allowed Samantha to answer without the options. But this one can go Uh-uhmm… I phoned my friend immediately and I said to her something is wrong. V/O Samantha Kemp and her husband were close friends with the Papapavlous until 2018… Samantha Raymond was a very light sleeper. Claire: Oh, really? He spent weekends here. So when I read he was sleeping, an intruder broke in and… It didn't make sense to me because I know Raymond … and then also his wallet and he smokes and everything else next to his bed that remained there. V/O Having known the couple intimately, Kemp insists some things don’t add up. Samantha They’ve got “varkhonde”. Claire: Yes. Yeah. And I know when we go visit them, he used to close those dogs because they were vicious and alert. Samantha: And I mean, there were people scared of the dogs, terrified. Wouldn't you be? Claire: I would but that’s a whole different story. Terrified. I mean, even us. Who knew some of the dogs were still terrified of them. V/O According to the widow their bull terrier was with her in the TV room. She has said that the attackers closed the door, blocking the dog from attack. Japie As die deur toegetrek is, waar sou die skote gewees het? Op die muur, nie in die deur nie. If the door was closed, where would the shots have been? On the wall, not in the door. Dawie En ons het hier aangekom en daai hond het nie eers vir ons geblaf nie. Hy was kalm, kalm, kalm. En daar was ‘n klein hondjie wat blykbaar by hom in die kamer was maar toe ons hier kom toe is hy toegemaak in ‘n hok agter. En niemand kan vir ons sê hoe die hond daar gekom het nie. We got here and that dog didn’t even bark at us. He was calm, calm. And there was a small dog that apparently was with him in the room but when we got here he was closed in a cage at the back, and no-one can explain how the dog got there. LINK The story took an even more bizarre turn with the arrest of Simoné’s friend at the end of October last year. V/O 22-year old Patricia Ray-Lee Smith was arrested and charged for conspiracy to commit murder. Japie Sy’t by my gewerk. Hulle was saam site agents, en ek dink dis waar hulle bevriend geraak het… dis maar daar by die werk. She worked for me. Together they were site agents. I think that’s where they befriended each other, at work. Claire: It was an innocent friendship from the outside? Daar was baie stories en ek het net gesê vir my gaan dit oor die werk. Ja there were many stories. There were many stories but I said for me it was about the job. V/O Another surprise waited in court. Simoné Papapavlou’s was cited as co-accused on the charge sheet, but she has not been arrested or charged. According to the media, police have found incriminating whatsapp messages between Smith and the widow, but the prosecution is not revealing any information while the investigation is ongoing. Dawie Claire: Do you still have questions? Baie baie en ek wens ek het antwoorde gehad. Maar daar is nog nie antwoorde nie. Many, many, many, and I wish I had the answers but there are no answers yet. V/O Raymond and Simone first met in 2015 and Kemp says there was instant chemistry. Samantha Claire: Who showed interest? Raymond showed interest first. Claire: Really, did he fall hard for her? Very. V/O But the fairytale did not last and many saw warning signs. Friends tried to warn Raymond. Samantha If she wanted something and he didn't give it to her, she would manipulate him with sex. Claire: She had control over him. Totally. My husband asked Raymond has she got like a spell on you, is there a voodoo doll. Can't you see the signs? So he just said he has to stand by her. V/O At the end of 2018 Raymond proposed, and Simoné asked Kemp to be her maid-of-honour. Samantha We were sitting outside the one morning and then she admitted to me she’s bisexual… and then I said I think the person that you’re marrying should know this first. And then after the conversation that they had she slammed down the phone and she said to me in Afrikaans “Ek hoop net hy sal vrek” and then I was like taken aback and then she said but she’ll make sure his policies are in order first. That was like… boom! V/O The couples’ friendship came to an end when Raymond insisted on going ahead with the wedding. Samantha Raymond just wanted a boeremeisie. Claire: Salt of the earth, simple. Simple, he just wanted a boeremeisie. And then he got this queen... LINK Even after they were married their relationship was rocky and they ended up separating for some months. But eventually Simoné sent Raymond this email to ask for a reconciliation. In it she says I am sorry for all the pain that I caused you, and I’m sorry for all the awful things that I said to you. Raymond I forgive you. Japie En toe het sy teruggekom en toe’s sy weer weg. Omtrent ‘n maand. En na die tyd toe vind ek uit Raymond moes ‘n kontrak teken, toe sy terugkom het sy hom ‘n kontrak maak teken dat alles hare is. En toe het sy die laaste keer teruggekom - begin laasjaar - en uhmm, my eerste woorde was “ek hoop jy is terug vir die regte redes. Vir my het hulle vir die eerste keer gelukkig gelyk. Ek het regtig gedink hulle is gelukkig. She came back, and then she left again, about a month later. Afterwards I found out Raymond had to sign a contract, when she came back she made him sign a contract that everything is hers. When she came back the last time, at the beginning of last year, my first words to her were: “I hope you’re back for the right reasons.” To me they looked happy for the first time. I really thought they were happy. Samantha He loved her so much he would tolerate anything that came in his way… and now he had to die... V/O We approached Simoné and her lawyer for comment, but they have not responded to any of the questions. Smith is currently out on bail, awaiting her next court appearance on the 11th of June. In the meantime family and friends just want answers. Japie Claire: And you believe that will bring a bit of closure if justice is done… or is too much lost already? Dit sal nooit die seer wegvat nie maar ten minste sal ek weet die skuldiges het nie weggekom nie. It will never take the pain away, but at least I will know the guilty parties did not get away with it. PROMO 1 The brutal murder of a young Limpopo farmer late last year left family and friends devastated, with more questions than answers. Was this a farm attack or something more sinister? PROMO 2 A young farmer was shot and killed in his sleep in October last year, but this was not your typical farm attack. Will family and friends get the answers they desperately need? PROMO 3 Another farm murder or something a lot more sinister? We trace the events of the night in October 2020 that left a young Limpopo farmer dead in his bed.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): We investigate a farm murder where all is not what it appears to be.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: A month after a farmer from Groblersdal was murdered, his widows girlfriend was arrested. Carte Blanche investigates...
metadata.Summary: After midnight of an early October evening in 2019 three shots rang out on a farm near Groblersdal in Limpopo. There was a moment's pause before seven more gunshots broke the early morning silence. Afterwards, a young farmer, Raymond Papapavlou lay dead. His wife of two years, Simoné was a broken woman. She later told police she had fallen asleep on a couch in the TV room, while her husband was asleep in the bedroom when their dog reacted to a shadow. Suddenly three shots rang out from within the bedroom. Raymond was mortally struck and Simoné, who had a pistol with her, fired seven "warning shots" into the wall. The intruder managed to escape and yet another farm murder was added to the statistics. But all did not seem to be what it appeared to be. The next morning two teams of professional trackers went over the farm with a fine toothed comb. Not a single strange track was found in the area surrounding the house.The window used as an entry point, according to Simoné, seemed suspiciously small. Big enough for a small child to gain silent access, but almost impossible for an adult sized intruder. A month later the small rural community was shocked when a 22-year old friend of Simon's, Patricia Ray-Lee Smith, was arrested and charged with murder and conspiracy to murder. An even greater surprise waited in Smith's charge sheet; Another name - Simoné Papapavlou. Up to date, Papapavlou has never been arrested and Smith was released on bail on 27 November 2020. We will be talking to farmer and road builder, Japie Jonker. He is Raymond Papapavlou's uncle. Jonker also rented the farm for Raymond and his young wife to stay on. Jonker will take CB to the farm and talk us through the events of that horrible night. At the moment our insert will consist of interviews with Jonker, as well as a member of the professional tracking team and also the private detective who traced and arrested Smith, ex-police colonel Gawie Louwrens..
